title: Apartment 27, Block F, Milner'S Square, Whitehall, Dublin 9
seoTitle: Apartment 27, Block F, Milner'S Square, Whitehall, Dublin 9
description:
iLiv Property Management is delighted to present this superb three-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment in Santry, Dublin 9, which has just undergone a comprehensive refurbishment by iBuild.
Finished to an exceptionally high standard throughout, the property is presented in fabulous, turnkey condition and is ready for immediate occupation. The refurbishment gives the apartment a fresh, modern feel throughout, making it an excellent option for tenants looking for a high-quality home in a well-connected North Dublin location.
The accommodation is particularly spacious, extending to approximately 95 sq. m., and comprises three generous bedrooms, two bathrooms including an en-suite, a large living/dining area, modern kitchen and excellent internal storage. The property also benefits from a south-west-facing balcony and designated underground parking. 
The apartment has been newly refurbished by iBuild, with considerable attention given to the overall finish and presentation. The result is a bright, contemporary home that is ready for its first occupants following the works.
Location
Santry is an extremely convenient location, offering excellent access to both Dublin City Centre and Dublin Airport. The area is well served by public transport, with a number of bus routes within a short walk providing connections towards the city centre, DCU and surrounding areas. Daft.ie
Local amenities include Omni Park Shopping Centre, Gulliver's Retail Park, Santry Demesne Regional Park, Morton Stadium, DCU and Beaumont Hospital, together with a wide selection of supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, gyms and everyday services. Fingal
For motorists, the property is particularly well positioned for access to the M1 and M50, as well as Dublin Airport and the wider Dublin road network. Blackwood Square
Key Features
- 3 spacious bedrooms
- 2 bathrooms
- Approx. 95 sq. m.
- Newly refurbished throughout by iBuild
- Finished to a very high standard
- Bright and spacious living/dining accommodation
- Modern kitchen
- Excellent storage
- South-west-facing balcony
- Designated underground parking
- Excellent Santry location
- Close to Omni Park, DCU, Beaumont Hospital and Santry Demesne
- Excellent access to Dublin City Centre, Dublin Airport, M1 and M50
- Ready to occupy
- Professionally managed by iLiv Property Management, including ongoing tenancy and maintenance management
This is a superb, newly refurbished three-bedroom home offering generous accommodation, an excellent finish and a highly convenient location. Early viewing is recommended.
